request: Analyze GSE77178 for PMID 32601609 (Exercise rejuvenates quiescent skeletal muscle stem cells in old mice through restoration of Cyclin D1.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq (SMARTer Ultra Low Input, HiSeq 2000) of FACS-isolated quiescent MuSCs, one mouse per profile (S1.19.p1, FIG11 a)

ccnd1: KO (separate young Ccnd1 genotype experiment, S0.p15)

final.sample_inclusion: Exercise experiment: Y(-Ex), Y(+Ex), O(-Ex), O(+Ex) quiescent MuSCs (S0.p7, FIG11). The Ccnd1 genotype series (Y(WT)/Y(HET)/Y(KO)/O(WT), S0.p15) is a separate experiment and not an exercise estimand.
final.primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running on the quiescent MuSC transcriptome in old mice: O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (S0.p7, S0.p9, FIG11 c)
planned_contrasts: O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (S0.p7; paper: 248 DEGs at 10% FDR; Ccnd1 top hit, up with exercise, S0.p9)
Y(+Ex) vs Y(-Ex) (S0.p7; paper: 35 DEGs at 10% FDR)
O(-Ex) vs Y(-Ex) aging reference used to call 130 of the 248 genes 'rejuvenated' (S0.p7; count not reported)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; each profile is an individual mouse (FIG11 a)
final.normalization: genes lacking Entrez ID or raw FPKM >= 1.5 in >= 3 samples removed (11,337 genes); raw counts normalized with RUVs k=6 for library prep and sample collection batch (S1.19.p3)
final.paper_method: edgeR negative binomial GLM likelihood ratio test, Cox-Reid tagwise dispersion, on RUVs-normalized raw counts, genes with normalized FPKM >= 6 in >= 3 samples; BH q-values (S1.19.p3)

named_genes: Ccnd1 (top hit, increased by exercise in old MuSCs)

final.paper_enrichment: GSEA Hallmark, Signal2Noise ranking, gene permutation (S1.19.p3, S0.p8, FIG5 b)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S0.p7 defines the exercise comparisons and the 10% FDR counts; S1.19.p3 defines filtering, RUVs normalization, edgeR LRT and BH q-values; S0.p9 and FIG11 c name Ccnd1 as the top O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) hit.

checks: GEO series GSE77178 contact lab Thomas A. Rando (paper's lab), MuSC RNA-seq, mouse male, titles O(-Ex)/O(+Ex)/Y(-Ex)/Y(+Ex) and Y(WT)/Y(HET)/Y(KO)/O(WT) match the paper's groups (S0.p7, S0.p15)
the deposited file holds 11,337 genes, the exact number the paper states after filtering (S1.19.p3)

ownership.reasoning: The supplementary file is the paper's processed table (11,337 genes, normalized FPKM plus Ccnd1 correlation coefficients described in S1.19.p4); group labels and the 2016/2018 submission split match the exercise and Ccnd1 experiments.

exclude_samples.GSM3197069: Ccnd1 genotype experiment (Y(WT), 2018 submission batch), not part of the exercise estimand (S0.p15)

final.key: title 'O(-Ex) replicate 1' -> 'O(-Ex)_1', equal to the matrix column names

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns are 'O(-Ex)_1' style; GEO titles are 'O(-Ex) replicate 1'. Deriving a key from title gives an exact match for all 36 samples. The 15 Ccnd1-genotype samples (submitted 2018, separate experiment S0.p15) are excluded so the exercise contrasts do not borrow variance from another batch; grp is the age x activity cell from the title.

final.source: GSE77178_ExerciseAgingCcnd1_MuSCRNASeq.txt.gz: 'Tab-delimited .txt file containing normalized FPKMs and Ccnd1 correlation coefficients for each gene' (GEO data_processing)
final.paper_input: edgeR on RUVs-normalized raw counts (S1.19.p3); raw counts are not deposited (supplementary_file NONE per sample)

matrix.reasoning: Values are non-integer (integer fraction 0), positive, median ~5.8, max ~10,500, consistent with FPKM; GEO data_processing says normalized FPKMs after RUVs k=6. Not counts, so edgeR/DESeq2 cannot run; log2(x+1) limma is the supported route.

design.reasoning: Four age x activity cells from one experiment (S0.p7, FIG11 a); the paper compares O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex), Y(+Ex) vs Y(-Ex), and O(-Ex) vs Y(-Ex) pairwise. One cell-means model on the 21 samples with planned contrasts, no pooling of levels. ccnd1 column is constant WT in these samples; activity alone would pool ages and is rejected.

candidates.reason_rejected: pools young and old, while the paper's estimand is exercise within age

candidates.value: include the 2018 Ccnd1 samples as extra controls
candidates.reason_rejected: separate experiment and submission batch; paper analyzes them separately (S0.p15)

covariates.name: RUVs factors (k=6)
covariates.disposition: not available as columns; already removed in the deposited normalized FPKM, cannot be re-entered in the model

covariance.reasoning: Each profile is a separate mouse (FIG11 a), so no blocking unit. The paper's batch adjustment (RUVs, S1.19.p3) is already applied to the deposited values; its W factors are not deposited, so the residual degrees of freedom are not reduced for them (possible mild anti-conservatism). No batch column in GEO metadata for these 21 samples.

final.method: limma (moderated t, empirical Bayes) on log2(FPKM+1)

paper_route.method: edgeR NB GLM LRT with Cox-Reid tagwise dispersion on RUVs-normalized raw counts
paper_route.reason: raw counts and RUVs W factors are not deposited; only RUVs-normalized FPKM is available

deviations: limma-trend style moderated t on log2(normalized FPKM+1) instead of edgeR LRT on counts
expression filter normalized FPKM >= 6 in >= 3 of the 21 exercise samples (paper: >= 3 samples, set unclear)
5 duplicated gene symbols (same Entrez, different Ensembl locus) kept first occurrence

method.reasoning: Matrix policy: FPKM goes to limma on log scale. The paper's edgeR route needs counts that are not deposited, so it is a declared deviation.

final.deviation_note: Paper's 10% BH FDR applied to limma BH-adjusted p; audit rule is the workflow default BH < 0.05.

threshold.reasoning: S0.p7: 'At a 10% false discovery rate'; S1.19.p3: Benjamini-Hochberg q-values; no fold-change cutoff stated.

caveats: limma on deposited RUVs-normalized FPKM instead of edgeR LRT on counts; counts not comparable one-to-one

study.reasoning: Paper's counts at 10% FDR (S0.p7) and its named top hit Ccnd1 (S0.p9: decreased with aging, restored by exercise).

discrepancies.paper: edgeR NB GLM LRT on RUVs-normalized raw counts (S1.19.p3)
exercise experiment analyzed separately from Ccnd1 genotype series

executions.name: limma_joint
executions.reasoning: One limma cell-means model on the 21 exercise-experiment samples with the paper's three pairwise contrasts; paper's FPKM >= 6 in >= 3 samples expression filter.

enrichment.reasoning: Paper ran Hallmark GSEA for O(+Ex) vs O(-Ex) (S0.p8, FIG5 b).
Paper ran Hallmark GSEA for Y(+Ex) vs Y(-Ex) (FIG5 b).
